name: Invoke Infernal Potency

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You are doomed

---
Effect If your next action is to cast either fear or spiritual armament as an innate spell, you can heighten the spell to a rank 1 lower than half your level rounded up. You then increase the value of your doomed condition by 1.
